user.title: Connect to the heat pump
user.description: Enable Modbus TCP in the pump's menu {menu} before continuing. The default port is 502 and the unit ID is normally 1.

confirm.title: What the pump looks like
confirm.description:
Found: {traits}.

Of the documented registers, {present} exist on this pump and {reporting} are reporting a value right now. {absent} are not implemented and will not be created.

Pick the model so the device gets the right name.

progress.discovering: Scanning the pump's registers. This takes about a minute and is only done once.

error.cannot_connect: No response. Check the IP address and that Modbus TCP is enabled in menu 7.5.9.
error.not_nibe: The device answers Modbus but does not look like a NIBE S-series. Check the unit ID.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This pump is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Lost contact with the pump during the register scan.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error during the register scan.

init.title: Settings
init.description: How often registers are read. Only registers backing an enabled entity are read, so more entities make each cycle longer.

rescan_registers.name: Rescan registers
rescan_registers.description: Probes the heat pump again and refreshes which registers exist.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: Which pump to rescan. Leave empty to rescan all.
